svg.title: Pinecall

g.text: VOICE & CHAT AGENTS, WRITTEN AS A CLASS

text.tspan: # the runtime, on this machine: open source, no account
models Ollama · Whisper · Kokoro · bge-m3, local
key yours, handed to the CLI: no login, no link
# an agent, written as a class: the same on both
pinecall new acme --agent front-desk && cd acme
gateway http://127.0.0.1:8080 · key from the local runtime
› Hello. How can I help you today?
# or Pinecall Cloud: sign up, nothing to run
open this to sign in: https://cloud.pinecall.io/cli?c=cli_…
signed in to https://cloud.pinecall.io as You
